messages:
Priya S: Heads-up — vendor posted a regional pricing change. h100 burst surcharge in eu-west-1 up ~18% effective next invoice. Seeing an immediate bump in estimated unit cost.

Jon W: source/link?

Priya S: https://portal.cloud/internal/vendor-notices/2026-03-17 (internal) — attached invoice diff sample in thread.

Martin K: quick calc: if we do nothing, net gross margin on Hosted drops ~3.2% at current traffic mix.

Elena R: ouch. what's the current burst share in eu-west-1?

Priya S: ~22% of h100 token-hours are burst machines; eu-west-1 is ~35% of our EU traffic.

Samira: Can we simply move burst capacity to us-central for the short term? latency/regulatory impact?

Martin K: Latency will increase for EU users; also some regulated tenants require EU residency. But for non-regulated/self-serve we can route.

Priya S: Proposed playbook:
1) Freeze new burst allocations in eu-west-1
2) Rebalance existing burst to us-central where tenant constraints allow
3) Accelerate EU reserved-commit repricing discussion (short term top-up offers)
4) Short-term pass-through surcharge for enterprise & temporary absorb for self-serve

Jon W: Implementation pieces: autoscaler tweaks, routing policy updates, billing tag changes, sales comms. Priorities?

Elena R: Autoscaler change we can push quickly. Suggest reducing burst pool target by 30% and prefer us regions for new allocations. Example command: 

```
redwoodctl autoscaler update --pool burst-eu --min 4 --max 10 --region-preference us-central
```
Will need a rollout window to avoid churn.

InfraBot: Deploy queued by @Elena R — autoscaler config update (deploy/8892).

FinanceBot: Scenario calc posted: baseline cost 0.045 $/token-hour -> +18% => 0.0531 $/token-hour. Impact dashboard: https://redwood.internal/fin/scenarios/7634

Martin K: If we shift ~60% of burst-hours to us-central we claw back ~1.8% margin. Remaining gap can be addressed via short-term packaging adjustments or commit top-ups.

Samira: Packaging suggestion: "EU burst buffer" add-on (monthly fee) or small uplift on dedicated/reserved pricing for new EU commits. Minimizes surprise for existing customers.

Priya S: Agreed on not surprising customers. Recommendation: (a) grandfather existing contracts, (b) offer opt-in add-on for new signups, (c) active sales outreach to large impacted tenants.

Jon W: Timeline — autoscaler + routing change can be pushed in ~2 hours, migrations take ~3–6 hours to settle.

Elena R: I'll schedule rollout 22:00 UTC (low traffic) and monitor latency + error rates.

FinanceBot: I'll produce a one-pager with unit-econ before/after and suggested packaging verbiage by EOD.

Priya S: Action items: Elena -> run rollout; Martin + Finance -> assemble margin model and packaging language; Jon + Samira -> validate routing/customer segmentation; Priya -> coordinate comms to sales/support. :thumbsup: 

Samira: happy to help draft sales collateral / FAQ. Ping me.

Elena R: Deploy in progress. Monitoring: https://grafana.redwood/d/abc/h100-burst-eu (watching cpu, p99 latency, errors).

Priya S: Closing loop — if any showstoppers, escalate to infra oncall immediately. Thanks all.

Jon W: ack

Martin K: taking finance action.

InfraBot: Deploy complete (deploy/8892) — autoscaler updated. Keep an eye on eviction events.

Priya S: noted, will follow up in morning with comms update.
